en.text: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

zhSimplified.text: 此后，我听见好像群众在天上大声说： 哈利路亚！ 救恩、荣耀、权能都属乎我们的 神！

footnotes.text: - 19:1 就是要赞美耶和华的意思

zhTraditional.text: 此後，我聽見好像群眾在天上大聲說： 哈利路亞！ 救恩、榮耀、權能都屬乎我們的上帝！

footnotes.text: - 19:1 就是要讚美耶和華的意思

en.text: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

zhSimplified.text: 他的判断是真实公义的； 因他判断了那用淫行败坏世界的大淫妇， 并且向淫妇讨流仆人血的罪， 给他们伸冤。

zhTraditional.text: 他的判斷是真實公義的； 因他判斷了那用淫行敗壞世界的大淫婦， 並且向淫婦討流僕人血的罪， 給他們伸冤。

en.text: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

zhSimplified.text: 又说： 哈利路亚！ 烧淫妇的烟往上冒， 直到永永远远。

zhTraditional.text: 又說： 哈利路亞！ 燒淫婦的煙往上冒， 直到永永遠遠。

en.text: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

zhSimplified.text: 那二十四位长老与四活物就俯伏敬拜坐宝座的 神，说： 阿们！哈利路亚！

zhTraditional.text: 那二十四位長老與四活物就俯伏敬拜坐寶座的上帝，說： 阿們！哈利路亞！

en.text: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

zhSimplified.text: 有声音从宝座出来说： 神的众仆人哪， 凡敬畏他的，无论大小， 都要赞美我们的 神！

zhTraditional.text: 有聲音從寶座出來說： 上帝的眾僕人哪， 凡敬畏他的，無論大小， 都要讚美我們的上帝！

en.text: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

zhSimplified.text: 我听见好像群众的声音，众水的声音，大雷的声音，说： 哈利路亚！ 因为主—我们的 神、 全能者作王了。

zhTraditional.text: 我聽見好像群眾的聲音，眾水的聲音，大雷的聲音，說： 哈利路亞！ 因為主－我們的上帝、 全能者作王了。

en.text: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们要欢喜快乐， 将荣耀归给他。 因为，羔羊婚娶的时候到了； 新妇也自己预备好了，

zhTraditional.text: 我們要歡喜快樂， 將榮耀歸給他。 因為，羔羊婚娶的時候到了； 新婦也自己預備好了，

en.text: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

zhSimplified.text: 就蒙恩得穿光明洁白的细麻衣。 （这细麻衣就是圣徒所行的义。）

zhTraditional.text: 就蒙恩得穿光明潔白的細麻衣。 （這細麻衣就是聖徒所行的義。）

en.text: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

zhSimplified.text: 天使吩咐我说：「你要写上：凡被请赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又对我说：「这是 神真实的话。」

zhTraditional.text: 天使吩咐我說：「你要寫上：凡被請赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又對我說：「這是上帝真實的話。」

en.text: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

zhSimplified.text: 我就俯伏在他脚前要拜他。他说：「千万不可！我和你，并你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄同是作仆人的，你要敬拜 神。」因为预言中的灵意乃是为耶稣作见证。

zhTraditional.text: 我就俯伏在他腳前要拜他。他說：「千萬不可！我和你，並你那些為耶穌作見證的弟兄同是作僕人的，你要敬拜上帝。」因為預言中的靈意乃是為耶穌作見證。

en.text: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

zhSimplified.text: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马，骑在马上的称为诚信真实，他审判，争战，都按着公义。

zhTraditional.text: 我觀看，見天開了。有一匹白馬，騎在馬上的稱為誠信真實，他審判，爭戰，都按着公義。

en.text: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

zhSimplified.text: 他的眼睛如火焰，他头上戴着许多冠冕；又有写着的名字，除了他自己没有人知道。

zhTraditional.text: 他的眼睛如火焰，他頭上戴着許多冠冕；又有寫着的名字，除了他自己沒有人知道。

en.text: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

zhSimplified.text: 他穿着溅了血的衣服；他的名称为 神之道。

zhTraditional.text: 他穿着濺了血的衣服；他的名稱為上帝之道。

en.text: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

zhSimplified.text: 在天上的众军骑着白马，穿着细麻衣，又白又洁，跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 在天上的眾軍騎着白馬，穿着細麻衣，又白又潔，跟隨他。

en.text: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

zhSimplified.text: 有利剑从他口中出来，可以击杀列国。他必用铁杖辖管他们，并要踹全能 神烈怒的酒榨。

zhTraditional.text: 有利劍從他口中出來，可以擊殺列國。他必用鐵杖轄管他們，並要踹全能上帝烈怒的酒醡。

en.text: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

zhSimplified.text: 在他衣服和大腿上有名写着说：「万王之王，万主之主。」

zhTraditional.text: 在他衣服和大腿上有名寫着說：「萬王之王，萬主之主。」

en.text: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

footnotes.text: 19:17 TR reads “supper of the great God” instead of “great supper of God”

zhSimplified.text: 我又看见一位天使站在日头中，向天空所飞的鸟大声喊着说：「你们聚集来赴 神的大筵席，

zhTraditional.text: 我又看見一位天使站在日頭中，向天空所飛的鳥大聲喊着說：「你們聚集來赴上帝的大筵席，

en.text: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

zhSimplified.text: 可以吃君王与将军的肉，壮士与马和骑马者的肉，并一切自主的为奴的，以及大小人民的肉。」

zhTraditional.text: 可以吃君王與將軍的肉，壯士與馬和騎馬者的肉，並一切自主的為奴的，以及大小人民的肉。」

en.text: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

zhSimplified.text: 我看见那兽和地上的君王，并他们的众军都聚集，要与骑白马的并他的军兵争战。

zhTraditional.text: 我看見那獸和地上的君王，並他們的眾軍都聚集，要與騎白馬的並他的軍兵爭戰。

en.text: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

zhSimplified.text: 那兽被擒拿；那在兽面前曾行奇事、迷惑受兽印记和拜兽像之人的假先知，也与兽同被擒拿。他们两个就活活地被扔在烧着硫磺的火湖里；

zhTraditional.text: 那獸被擒拿；那在獸面前曾行奇事、迷惑受獸印記和拜獸像之人的假先知，也與獸同被擒拿。他們兩個就活活地被扔在燒着硫磺的火湖裏；

en.text: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

zhSimplified.text: 其余的被骑白马者口中出来的剑杀了；飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的被騎白馬者口中出來的劍殺了；飛鳥都吃飽了他們的肉。
